problems.title: FizzBuzz
problems.prompt: Print numbers 1..15, but print `Fizz` for multiples of 3, `Buzz` for multiples of 5, and `FizzBuzz` for multiples of both.
hints: Use a switch with modulo cases.
problems.expectedOutput:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz

problems.title: Reverse a string
problems.prompt: Reverse a string by runes so multibyte characters stay intact. Print the reverse of `hello`.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.prompt: Given `nums` and a `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. For `[2, 7, 11, 15]` and target `9`, print the indices separated by a space.
hints: Store each value's index in a map as you scan.
For each n, look up target-n.

problems.title: Palindrome check
problems.prompt: Return whether a string reads the same forwards and backwards. Print the result for `racecar`.
hints: Return false on the first mismatch.

problems.title: Word frequency map
problems.prompt: Count word frequencies (split on spaces) and print words that appear more than once, sorted alphabetically as `word:count` lines.
hints: Collect keys with count > 1, sort with slices.Sort, then print.
